qualification.education_qualification: M.Sc. in Physics/ Photonics or 1st class B.E./ B.Tech. in relevant engineering, Ph.D. in Physics/ Optical/ Electrical.
qualification.details: Jr. Research Fellow: 1st class M.Sc. in Physics/ Photonics or 1st class B.E./ B.Tech. in Engineering/ Physics/ Optical/ Electrical/ Electronics/ Instrumentation/ Computer Science and Engineering. Must have qualified national-level examination such as GATE, UGC-NET or equivalent. Desirable: hands-on experience in spectroscopic instrumentation and Raman spectroscopy. NET/ GATE relaxed for CFTI graduates with CGPA >8.000. Research Associate: Ph.D. in Physics/ Optical Engineering/ Electrical Engineering/ Electronics Engineering/ Instrumentation Engineering/ Computer Science or related field. Desirable: understanding of lasers and photodetectors (CCD/ CMOS, ICCD, APD, SPADs), hands-on spectroscopic instrumentation, at least two SCI-indexed research papers, experience in writing papers/ reports/ patents.

salary_details.details: Jr. Research Fellow: Rs 37,000/ - p.m. plus HRA @27% Research Associate: Rs 58,000/ - p.m. plus HRA @27%

Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 25-09-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

content_sections.heading: IIT Delhi Vacancy 2026 Details
content_sections.text: A total of 3 vacancies are available - 1 for Jr. Research Fellow and 2 for Research Associate.

content_sections.heading: IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Jr. Research Fellow: 1st class M.Sc. in Physics/ Photonics or 1st class B.E./ B.Tech. in Engineering/ Physics/ Optical/ Electrical/ Electronics/ Instrumentation/ Computer Science and Engineering. Must have qualified national-level examination such as GATE, UGC-NET or equivalent. Desirable: hands-on experience in spectroscopic instrumentation and Raman spectroscopy. NET/ GATE relaxed for CFTI graduates with CGPA >8.000. Research Associate: Ph.D. in Physics/ Optical Engineering/ Electrical Engineering/ Electronics Engineering/ Instrumentation Engineering/ Computer Science or related field. Desirable: understanding of lasers and photodetectors (CCD/ CMOS, ICCD, APD, SPADs), hands-on spectroscopic instrumentation, at least two SCI-indexed research papers, experience in writing papers/ reports/ patents.

content_sections.heading: IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026 - Salary / Stipend

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Delhi Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 25-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications via email for the IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026 is 25th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Jr. Research Fellow / Research Associate posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced for the Jr. Research Fellow and Research Associate positions at IIT Delhi.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Jr. Research Fellow?
faq.answer: For Jr. Research Fellow, candidates need a 1st class M.Sc. in Physics/Photonics or a 1st class B.E./B.Tech. in relevant engineering fields, along with a qualified national-level exam.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for a Research Associate at IIT Delhi?
faq.answer: The salary for a Research Associate is Rs. 58,000/- per month plus HRA @27%.

faq.question: Q5. Is there an application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to apply through email for the IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by an online interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section on this page.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The positions of Jr. Research Fellow and Research Associate are contractual roles.
